fusions.name: Unhurried Nick
fusions.desc: A lazy cut that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Close
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 10 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 12 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drift and Mend
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Lingering Wake
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
